Publication.Description: Facts about a whole publication: magazine, zine, journal, newsletter or mook. Covers the run as a whole; changes over time go in the history section.

Fields.Description: Publisher or parent company. Repeat for successive publishers, with years: Petersen Publishing (1963–1996).
Person or company that founded the publication.
Current editor, or the final editor of a closed title. Earlier editors go in the article text.
Current or final schedule in plain words: Monthly, Every two months, Quarterly, Two issues a year.
Formats currently or last published: Print, Digital.
Designation of the first issue as printed: March 1980, No. 1 (Winter 2000/2001).
Designation of the final issue. Leave out unless closure is established.
Country of publication.
City where the editorial office is or was.
Language of the editorial content.
A cited figure with its year and what it measures: 55,000 print run (2016).
ISSN, with the medium when there are several: 0198-1056 (print).
Official website as a Markdown link to the full URL, showing only the host name without www.

PublicationIssue.Description: Facts about one issue of a publication.

Fields.Description: Link to the publication's article: [*Cinefex*](/cinefex).
Volume and number as printed: No. 1, Volume 3 - Issue 2.
Date printed on the cover, kept as printed: March 1980, Winter 1984–85.
Date the print edition went on sale, only when a source gives it.
Date the digital edition was released, only when a source gives it.
Editor credited in this issue's masthead.
Person or subject on the cover. Repeat for alternate covers.
Cover photographer or artist as credited in the issue.
Printed page count including covers, when counted or stated.
Price printed on the cover. Repeat for each currency: US$4.95, £3.50.
Formats this issue appeared in: Print, Digital.
ISSN printed on this issue.
13-digit barcode number printed on the cover.
2-digit add-on to the EAN-13 barcode, usually the issue number.
UPC barcode number printed on the cover (North American issues).
